rationale: Primary and runoff are LATER from county-posted reports (county totals printed on election night; precinct files produced days later or, for the runoff, as a PDF created the next day). Two LATER give COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. The runoff call is weak: the precinct report's printed run time (7:47 PM) is on election night.
